findings.current: Maybe he’d lived long enough not to care.
findings.defect: “Not to care” adds indifference. The source wonders whether he charged because he had lived long enough, without specifying that he no longer cared.
findings.rationale: The Korean says 살 만큼 살아서 그런 걸까—whether he had lived enough. The following sentence separately offers radiation contamination as a reason he lost his fear.

summary: One minor nuance shifts the reason for the Defense Minister’s fearlessness; the rest is faithful to the source.
